vertebrae.extractors.huggingface_text
=====================================

.. py:module:: vertebrae.extractors.huggingface_text

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Optional Hugging Face text embedding extractor.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   vertebrae.extractors.huggingface_text.HFTextExtractor


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: HFTextExtractor(name, model_id, pooling = 'mean', hidden_layer = None, batch_size = 32, max_length = 512, device = None, revision = None, trust_remote_code = False, tokenizer_kwargs = None, model_kwargs = None)

   Hugging Face text backbone extractor with explicit pooling.

   :param name: User-facing extractor name.
   :param model_id: Hugging Face model identifier or local path.
   :param pooling: Pooling mode: `"mean"`, `"cls"`, or `"last_token"`.
   :param hidden_layer: Optional hidden-state layer index to pool from. Defaults to
                        the model's final output.
   :param batch_size: Number of texts encoded per batch.
   :param max_length: Tokenizer truncation length.
   :param device: Optional device string.
   :param revision: Optional model revision.
   :param trust_remote_code: Whether to allow remote model code.
   :param tokenizer_kwargs: Extra keyword arguments for `AutoTokenizer`.
   :param model_kwargs: Extra keyword arguments for `AutoModel`.


   .. py:method:: fit(X, y = None)

      No-op fit for frozen Hugging Face text models.

      :param X: Input text samples.
      :param y: Optional labels.

      :returns: This extractor.



   .. py:method:: transform(X)

      Encode text inputs into dense embeddings.

      :param X: Sequence of strings.

      :returns: Dense float32 embedding matrix.

      :raises ImportError: If optional Hugging Face dependencies are missing.
      :raises ValueError: If inputs are invalid.



   .. py:method:: fit_transform(X, y = None)

      Encode text inputs into dense embeddings.

      :param X: Sequence of strings.
      :param y: Optional labels.

      :returns: Dense float32 embedding matrix.



   .. py:method:: recipe()

      Return a serializable Hugging Face text recipe.

      :returns: JSON-compatible recipe dictionary.
